messages:
noah: Created PR merging airgap packaging checklist + HSM appendix. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999

riley: Saw one broken cross-ref to #hsm-network; recommend adding an alias anchor to avoid breaking customer links.

fin: Added DKMS note for kernel modules and small packager snippet for offline bundles:

```
mkdir -p bundle/vendor/hsm
cp /opt/vendor/libvendorpkcs11.so bundle/vendor/hsm/
cp /opt/vendor/driver.ko bundle/vendor/hsm/
sha256sum bundle/vendor/hsm/* > bundle/vendor/hsm/CHECKSUMS
tar czf redwood-offline.tgz bundle
```

infra: Also include vendor .deb/.rpm if applicable and list module ABI in README. DKMS recommended for different kernels.

docbot: Lint: broken_links=1, anchors_missing=1, toc_missing=1

noah: Action: I'll add alias anchor + TOC entry; fin will add snippet into PR; infra will confirm DKMS wording. Merge after quick signoff.
